scenes.headline: How a 309B model stays fast at 256K context
scenes.sub: MiMo-V2-Flash: 128-token windows, one global layer in six, and built-in drafting.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Harp! Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Flash is a three hundred nine billion parameter mixture of experts, fifteen billion active. Here's how it serves long context quickly.

scenes.label: The bet
scenes.text: Most attention is local. Let five of every six layers see only 128 tokens, and buy back full reach with one global layer.
scenes.say: The bet: most of what attention does is local. So five of every six layers see only the last hundred twenty-eight tokens, and one global layer restores full reach.

scenes.title: Five local layers, then one global

steps.say: Forty-eight layers, in eight blocks of six. After the first block, each feed-forward routes to eight of two hundred fifty-six experts.
Five sliding-window layers each look back a hundred twenty-eight tokens. Stacked, their reach compounds, like small convolutions, so information travels several windows back.

steps.note: full context, at a sixth of the cost
steps.say: Then every sixth layer attends to the whole sequence, and mixes whatever the local layers couldn't reach.

scenes.label: less KV-cache storage and attention compute at long context, per the report
scenes.note: long-context quality holds: best open LongBench V2 score
scenes.say: Why bother? Past a hundred twenty-eight tokens, the sliding layers' caches stop growing. Only the global sixth keeps scaling, so the cache shrinks nearly six times.

items.say: A multi-token prediction head, trained in pretraining and replicated three layers deep, drafts several tokens ahead.

items.text: The main model verifies in one pass
items.say: The full model checks the draft in one pass, with an acceptance length that reaches about three point six tokens.
That's self-speculative decoding, with no separate draft model: up to two point six times faster.

scenes.text: Spend attention where it matters: most layers local and cheap, one global layer in six to keep the reach.
scenes.say: So spend attention where it matters. Keep most layers local and cheap, and one global layer in six keeps the reach.

recap: Five 128-token window layers, then one global
The cache shrinks nearly 6x at long context
A built-in MTP module drafts for itself
scenes.say: To recap: tiny windows, one global layer in six, a smaller cache, and a model that drafts for itself.
